title: Analysis of axonal growth in organotypic neural cultures
protocol: Reconstitute lyophilized neurotrophic factor in sterile milli-Q H2O not less than 100 µg/ml.
Store reconstituted solutions at 4°C for up to 2-7 days or below -18°C for long-term storage.
Add a carrier protein (0.1% BSA or HSA) to the solution in sterile milli-Q H2O when preparing for long-term storage.
Prevent freeze-thaw cycles of the reconstituted neurotrophic factor solutions.
Further dilute the 100 µg/ml NF solution to prepare a working solution of 5 µg/ml.
Mix 450 μl rat tail collagen with 50 μl 10x basal Eagle’s medium and 2 μl 7.5% sodium bicarbonate solution.
Add 1 μl of the neurotrophic factor stock solution (at 5 µg/ml) to achieve a final concentration of 10 ng/ml in the matrix.
Mix well with the collagen, keeping the mixture on ice to avoid gelification.
Perform a fast spin in a small spinning centrifuge.
Add 30 μl of the matrix on polylysine-coated round coverslips placed in 24-well dishes for DRG or in small petri dishes for SC slices (3 coverslips per dish).
Incubate at least two hours to allow proper gelification.
Coat coverslips with poly-D-lysine before adding the collagen drop to improve adhesion of the 3D matrix.
Anesthetize rats of postnatal day 7 by hypothermia and decapitate.
Dissect spinal cord (lumbar segments) and DRG (low thoracic and lumbar) over a cold plate.
Place dissected samples in cold Gey’s balanced salt solution enriched with glucose (final concentration 6mg/ml).
Clean samples from blood and meningeal debris.
Transfer cleaned samples to fresh cold Gey’s-glucose solution.
Cut spinal cords into 350µm thick slices using a McIlwain Tissue Chopper.
Maintain spinal cord slices in ice-cold Gey’s solution.
Prepare collagen droplets (30µl each) for petri dishes or 24 well plates and keep at 37°C.
Transfer tissue explants on the prepared collagen droplets using a microspoon.
Embed each tissue explant with another 30µl drop of ice-cold collagen solution to avoid gelification.
Transfer the dishes into an incubator (5% CO2, 37°C) until the matrix is gelled (approximately 40 min).
Add Neurobasal complete warm medium (500µl in 24 well plates and 1.5ml in petri dish).
Incubate cultures on orbital shaker inside the incubator.
Fix cultures with 4% PFA, pH 7.4 for ½ hour at room temperature in dishes.
Wash fixed cultures with TBSL for 20 minutes at room temperature in a shaker x 2.
Remove the slices from the culture dish and place them in a 24-well box using forceps or a small brush.
Heat citrate buffer pH 6.1 in a glass tube until boiling in a microwave.
Pour heated citrate buffer into the wells containing the slices.
Leave the slices in the citrate buffer for at least 1 hour at room temperature.
Wash the slices with TBSL for 5 minutes at room temperature in a shaker.
Incubate the slices in methanol diluted to 50% in H2O for 10 minutes.
Incubate the slices in methanol diluted to 70% in H2O for 20 minutes.
Incubate the slices in pure methanol (100%) for 20 minutes.
Wash the slices with TBSL for 20 minutes, twice at room temperature in a shaker.
Incubate the slices with primary antibody in TBS containing 0.3% Triton X100 and specific serum for 48 hours at 4°C.
Wash the slices with TBSL for 1 hour three times in a shaker.
Incubate the slices with secondary antibody in TBS containing 0.3% Triton X100 and specific serum overnight at 4°C, filter the secondary antibody using a syringe and sterile filter before incubation.
Wash the slices with TBSL for 1 hour twice in a shaker.
Wash the slices with TBS for 1 hour in a shaker.
Wash the slices with TB for 1 hour in a shaker.
Dehydrate directly in the wells if the slices are still attached to the round coverslips.
Mount the slices on a gelatine coated coverslip and let them dry at 35/40°C on a heating plate.
Incubate in ethanol 70% for 1 minute.
Incubate in ethanol 96% for 1 minute.
Incubate in ethanol 96% for 1 minute.
Incubate in ethanol 100% for 1 minute.
Incubate in ethanol 100% for 1 minute.
Dry from the ethanol and cover with Mowiol containing DAPI (1:1000).
Use an epifluorescence microscope with a digital camera to take microphotographs.
Ensure the resolution is at least 10X objective to see all neurites.
Capture multiple images to form a mosaic if the neurite arbor does not fit into a single image.
Reconstruct and photomerge culture images using Adobe Photoshop CS4 or similar software.
Define optimal imaging conditions by testing different settings and analyzing images.
Enhance images and generate measurable images for analysis.
Install the Neurite-J plug-in for ImageJ.
Open a frame window to provide user interaction with the plug-in.
Use the plug-in to measure neurite growth semi-automatically.
